summary: The comfort path is an auto-served, non-plan reading rotation (COMFORT_CHAPTERS in src/data/comfort.ts) delivered through ComfortSection.tsx plus ComfortVerseBannerSection.tsx, wrapped by persona gating in HomeScreen.tsx and feature/section config in persona-config.ts:503-555. It shares the app's generic audio player, plan/streak plumbing, and AI endpoint (with a comfort-tuned system prompt) rather than having any bespoke audio, plans-catalog, or crisis-detection code. PrayerGlobe.tsx and netlify/functions/prayer-wall.js are NOT part of the comfort path — they are used only in MessagesScreen.tsx, unrelated to any comfort sectionOrder key. The only explicit crisis-support surface is a static, non-AI-triggered 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline line plus a "Reach Out"/pastoral-care email card, gated on setup?.persona==='comfort' in MoreScreen.tsx (More tab), not in ComfortSection or the AI chat itself.

Shows one of 16 rotating verses (by localDayIndex) plus a toggleable guided prayer of 4 rotating prayers.

renders_in_order.gate: not a sectionOrder key; always present, auto-fed the day's comfort chapter
renders_in_order.what_it_does: Plays/loads today's comfort chapter as the app's generic hero reading panel.

renders_in_order.what_it_does: Deliberately suppressed for comfort to avoid a confusing 'No reading plan active' message.
Auto-loads and displays the day's COMFORT_CHAPTERS entry, translation picker, listen button, post-read devotion, and the read-another/set-daily-amount flow.
Comfort-worded card inviting the user to talk to Bible AI about feelings; opens BibleAI with a comfort-tuned system prompt (persona-config.ts:551).

renders_in_order.what_it_does: Nothing renders; ComfortCard was retired per ComfortVerseBannerSection.tsx:1-6 comment, its guided-prayer feature merged into the verse banner.
Shows the two comfort-relevant book recommendation cards.
On the More tab only (not Home): mailto care@futures.church link plus static '988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline' text; not part of the comfort Home flow and not AI-triggered.

first_visit: On first Home load for the comfort persona, HomeScreen renders (in sectionOrder from persona-config.ts:510-519): greeting → comfort_verse_banner → hero_audio → scripture (suppressed) → comfort_scripture → ai_prompt → comfort_card (dead) → book_cards, per the render order table. ComfortSection auto-loads day's chapter from COMFORT_CHAPTERS by localDayIndex (ComfortSection.tsx:49-63,81), shows translation picker, chapter text via ScripturePassage, and a "Sit with this" reflection prompt once text loads (ComfortSection.tsx:177-204). Tapping "I'm finished reading" (ComfortSection.tsx:189-202) surfaces a post-read devotion if COMFORT_DEVOTIONS has one for that chapter (ComfortSection.tsx:208-258), then an "ask_more" choice — read another / enough today (ComfortSection.tsx:261-295); after 2 chapters served with no daily amount set, it switches to "ask_lock" offering to fix a daily amount of 1/2/3 chapters (ComfortSection.tsx:297-356), then a "done" card (ComfortSection.tsx:358-381).
return_visit: On return, comfortDailyAmount is read from localStorage dw_comfort_daily (ComfortSection.tsx:54-56) or synced value; if set (>0), the flow auto-advances through that many chapters per day without re-asking (advanceAfterDevotion, ComfortSection.tsx:65-79) and shows "reading X of Y" (ComfortSection.tsx:95-98) instead of "take your time." The comfort chapter index still rotates daily by localDayIndex() (ComfortSection.tsx:20-23, 49-51) so a new day serves a new chapter regardless of amount setting. The user can change their daily amount later via "comfort_change_daily" link on the done card (ComfortSection.tsx:367-379), which reopens ask_lock. Streak/greeting continue to update per the completion_and_streak field; the streak count itself stays hidden from the UI for this persona (HomeScreen.tsx:2004-2006) even as it accrues.
completion_and_streak: Comfort's own "I'm finished reading" button (ComfortSection.tsx:189-202) only sets local React state (comfortChaptersServed, comfortPostRead) — it does not call recordStreakToday or write dw_reading_done. The streak itself is stamped for every persona including comfort by an unconditional useEffect on Home mount (src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx:786-795, recordStreakToday()), and separately by handleMarkRead if the user taps "Mark as read" on the hero card (src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx:716-729). The streak counter UI is deliberately hidden for comfort (and new_to_faith) "to avoid pressure" (src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx:2004-2006), so the streak accrues silently in the background. There is a separate per-user "daily amount" setting (1/2/3 chapters, ComfortSection.tsx:305-327) stored to localStorage dw_comfort_daily and synced via syncMisc (ComfortSection.tsx:314-315) — this governs auto-advance through comfort chapters, not the streak.
audio: Audio uses the shared app-wide player, not a comfort-specific component. ComfortSection.tsx:129-146 renders a Listen/Pause button wired to the handleListen/audioPlaying/audioLoading/audioCurrentPassage props passed down from HomeScreen (same handleListen defined at src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx:753). The hero card independently auto-loads/can play the same day's comfort chapter reference via src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx:1303-1305.
ai: Comfort persona gets its own AI system-prompt addition (lead with comfort before teaching; if deep distress, gently encourage talking to a pastor or trusted friend) at src/utils/persona-config.ts:551. Home shows a comfort-specific AI entry card (BibleAIPromptSection, src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx:2918, copy block 564-568) that self-hides once dw_behavior_v1 logs an ai_prompt event. Selected text opens the highlight toolbar with comfortMode=true (src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx:4571) which can launch BibleAI. No crisis/self-harm detection exists in the AI code itself: grepping crisis/suicide/self-harm/988/lifeline across src/components/BibleAI.tsx and netlify/functions/claude.js returns nothing — the AI never inspects user text for distress signals or triggers the 988 line; that number is static copy elsewhere, not AI-driven.
copy_keys: reflect_prompt_comfort / sit_with_this (HomeScreen.tsx:3206-3210 — inside the dead 'devotion_scripture' section, see gap)
pastoral_care copy (MoreScreen.tsx block near 786-822, hardcoded strings not i18n keys)
self_serve_levers: Daily chapter amount (1/2/3) is user-chosen in-app at the ask_lock step, ComfortSection.tsx:305-327 — no dev needed to change a given user's pace.
Translation choice among COMFORT_TRANSLATIONS is user-selectable, ComfortSection.tsx:104-122.
dev_needed_today: Changing the rotating chapters that serve comfort (COMFORT_CHAPTERS list) requires editing src/data/comfort.ts — not exposed in UI.
Changing the 16 comfort verses or 4 guided prayers requires editing the hardcoded arrays in src/sections/ComfortVerseBannerSection.tsx:13-37.
Changing which two book cards show (grace-and-truth, no-more-fear) requires editing persona-config.ts:534.
Changing the AI system-prompt tone for comfort requires editing persona-config.ts:549-554; no admin toggle exists.

The comfort_card section key in sectionOrder (persona-config.ts:517) is dead — ComfortCard was retired and nothing in HomeScreen.tsx checks sectionOrder.includes('comfort_card'); reviving or removing it needs a dev.
The 'scripture' section for comfort renders nothing (intentionally suppressed, HomeScreen.tsx:3109-3115) since comfort has no reading slots/plan; changing that logic is code-only.
Adding real crisis-language detection/988 surfacing inside the AI chat (currently absent from BibleAI.tsx/claude.js) would require new development, not a config change.
Pastoral Care card (mailto:care@futures.church, static 988 text) is hardcoded in MoreScreen.tsx:784-822 — editable only by a dev.
tests_that_lock_behaviour: No comfort-specific automated tests were found among the named files; this reflects only the files reviewed, not a full-repo test search.
